mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log( admin_id, target_table, target_pk, before_value, after_value, reason_code, processed_at ) VALUES( #{adminId}, #{targetTable}, #{targetPk}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{reasonCode}, COALESCE(#{processedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )

where.if: AND ( target_admin.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{targetKeyword}, '%') OR acc.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{targetKeyword}, '%') OR target_account.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{targetKeyword}, '%') OR al.target_pk LIKE CONCAT('%', #{targetKeyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT al.audit_id, al.admin_id, al.target_table, al.target_pk, al.before_value, al.after_value, al.reason_code, al.processed_at, au.name AS admin_name, au.role AS admin_role, target_admin.name AS target_admin_name, acc.account_no AS target_account_no, target_account.account_no AS target_owner_account_no, target_batch.executed_at AS target_batch_executed_at FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON au.admin_id = al.admin_id LEFT JOIN admin_user target_admin ON al.target_table = 'ADMIN_USER' AND CAST(target_admin.admin_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON al.target_table = 'SELL_ORDER' AND CAST(so.order_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = so.account_id LEFT JOIN account target_account ON al.target_table = 'ACCOUNT' AND CAST(target_account.account_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk LEFT JOIN settlement_batch target_batch ON al.target_table = 'SETTLEMENT_BATCH' AND CAST(target_batch.batch_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk
ORDER BY al.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON au.admin_id = al.admin_id LEFT JOIN admin_user target_admin ON al.target_table = 'ADMIN_USER' AND CAST(target_admin.admin_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON al.target_table = 'SELL_ORDER' AND CAST(so.order_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = so.account_id LEFT JOIN account target_account ON al.target_table = 'ACCOUNT' AND CAST(target_account.account_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk LEFT JOIN settlement_batch target_batch ON al.target_table = 'SETTLEMENT_BATCH' AND CAST(target_batch.batch_id AS CHAR(20)) = al.target_pk
